13225.d: Haunted Mine is a quest that explores the depths of a maze-like mine located south of Mort Myre swamp rumoured to contain powerful crystals infused with Saradomin's power.

gt.heading: Transporting the fungus
gt.text:
Pick up a few glowing fungus (J) and place one in the southernmost cart (K).

You must now make use of the points settings (L), which display a track map, to operate the cart system and move the fungus to the desired spot, marked by ladders on the top-right of the map. Pressing the red start button will set the cart system in motion. The objective is to get the cart from the start position on the left to the exit point at the ladder in the top right corner (north-west). If you fail, you can simply retry but you will need to replace the fungus.

The map also shows two groups of levers controlling the junctions, marked with letters. The levers A through E are south-east of the control panel, whereas F through J are north, around the corner. Examining them reveals to which they correspond. Beware of skeletal miners lying in ambush at both stations. In order to get the cart towards the correct exit, study the route map carefully. The levers F, G and H cannot be pulled, as they are inaccessible. These junctions are therefore fixed, limiting your options. The cart will follow the (bright) crimson route at any junction when approaching from the tail direction of the corresponding arrow. Pulling the respective lever exchanges the (bright) crimson and (dull) burgundy arrows at the junction. When approaching a junction from the arrow head's direction, its orientation (i.e. colour) does not matter as long as it is a straight path. In order to round a corner and not plunge into a wall or the water, the direction taken by the cart must be marked by a crimson arrow.

ABCDE Map.png | The east set of levers
FGHIJK Map.png | The north set of levers
Points Setting interface.png | The desired track map

The starting position of the points levers (arrows on the map) varies between players, so the levers that need to be pulled will differ based on this. Pull whichever levers need to be changed in order to match the 'desired track map' above. Note that the visual appearance of the lever does not change, you must check the map to see which direction each switch is. Check that the points settings map matches this before proceeding. Once you have loaded the fungus and set the right path, press 'Start' on the track map.

If you've done this correctly, a dialogue box will appear where you wonder whether the cart ended up anywhere useful. If you end up sinking your cart, you must place another glowing fungus in it.

13239.d: Havenhythe is a landmass east of Morytania being released in a series of updates in 2026, starting with the western part on 23 March.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Getting to Havenhythe for the first time requires starting and progressing through the quest Visions of Havenhythe, started at the Rusty Anchor Tavern in Port Sarim. If left prior to completing the quest, Captain Lorris is the only method to return to Havenhythe. After completing the quest, the following become available:
• Wendlewick lodestone located in Wendlewick.
• At level 28 Magic, Wendlewick Teleport can be cast on the standard spellbook, teleporting to the centre of the town.
• Fairy ring BKS takes you to the Shrine of Inanna, south of Wendlewick.
• Boss portals and their variants to Ivar, King of Bones and Silverquill, the Dreadhog.

After the village of Amberfell is visited for the first time, it can be accessed via the fairy ring code DLP.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
One can use the fairy ring code CLS for quick transportation to and from the island. The fairy ring is located just behind Hazelmere's house.

Alternatively, use the Yanille lodestone and head east.

gt.heading: Transport method
gt.text:
Talk to Rosie (supplies) at the Waiko market about the plight of the moai. She tells you to inquire with Sea Witch Kaula on Whale's Maw, who knows an ancient song about the transportation of moai. Visit her on the north-west part of Whale's Maw. The witch tells you the sad tale about the moai of Whale's Maw; out of curiosity about the ocean, he begged the islanders to bring him to the seaside. The islanders made a basket of bamboo, filled it with the island's soil, and placed the moai in it. The workers exhausted themselves pushing him to the edge of the water, only for the high tide to roll in. With the islanders too exhausted to push him back inland, he was swept away by the high tides and drowned, his death screams echoing through the moai network.

Returning to Rosie on Waiko, the two of you realise that moai can be moved as long as they remain in contact with the soil from their native island. She gives you a Soil bag and tells you to fill it with Aminishi soil. Head back to Aminishi, walk to the bottom of the steps and fill the bag (standing on the dock works). Head back to Rosie who asks for 5 bamboo and 150 chimes. From this, she will make a basket filled with Aminishi soil, in which to keep the moai in during transport.

Rosie will handle the delivery of the goods. At this point, before leaving Waiko, you may wish to use the bank chest there to prepare for a fight scaled to your combat level in the next step.
